strings.en:
Hey, young'un. Could ya deliver this to
the Undying for me?{1a}Ya might not know who I mean by the
Undying. It's that young fella over at
Sadiya-san's place, name of Fatum.{1a}Huh? Why don't I go myself?{1a}Well, pal... 'cause he scares me, that's
why, obviously.{1a}So long, I'm countin' on ya!{0c:fe}

Why don't I go myself? // Well, pal... 'cause he scares me, that's why, obviously. // So long, I'm countin' on ya!

[HERO], it's all yours. I pass on anything that's a pain. I mean, there's no reward, right?

おつかいなんて下っ端の仕事、
